summary: This is a VS Code development container configuration file that sets up a Python development environment running in Docker. It specifies which Docker container to use, which VS Code extensions to install, and detailed editor settings for formatting and linting Python code along with other file types. The configuration ensures consistent code style and development tools across the team by enforcing rules for Python (using Black formatter and Pylance), as well as formatting rules for JSON, YAML, markdown, and shell scripts.

explanations.3: This points to a Docker Compose file that defines the container setup; the path goes up one directory level and references compose.yaml.
explanations.6: This specifies which service name from the Docker Compose file should be used—in this case, 'app_python'.
explanations.7: This sets the username that will be used inside the container when VS Code connects to it.
explanations.8: This is the folder inside the container where your project files will be located and where VS Code will open by default.
explanations.66: This tells VS Code to automatically run certain code fixing actions whenever you save a file—in this case, fixing all issues and organizing imports.
explanations.88: This is a fallback setting for all file types: run the 'fixAll' action explicitly (meaning you have to trigger it manually, unlike the Python-specific setting above).
explanations.102: These numbers set vertical guidelines in the editor at column 120 and column 70 to help you see when lines get too long.
explanations.118: This section hides certain folders (like .cache and .git) from the file explorer so they don't clutter the sidebar.
explanations.129: This passes a command-line argument to the mypy type checker, telling it to use a specific configuration file.
explanations.139: This enables strict type checking in Python, meaning mypy will enforce strict rules about type hints and type safety.
explanations.142: This sets Pylance as the language server, which provides intelligent code completion, error detection, and other code analysis features for Python.
